description: This file defines a Java class 'ConsumerClosedStatusReport' that encapsulates information about a closed MessageConsumer, including a factory method for creation and a getter for the consumer.

classes.name: ConsumerClosedStatusReport

methods.description: Returns the MessageConsumer associated with this report.
